song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Whenever affliction, dealing slight anguish, comes within the mind’s reach —
then alone, Lord, my nondifference from You: the hymn rains supreme nectar.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mānasagocaram eti yadaiva kleśadaśā tanutāpavidhātrī nātha ! tadaiva mama tvadabhedas stotraparāmṛtavṛṣṭiḥ udeti

verses.rejected: (a) after-it sequencing → killed: with-it is the inversion. (b) nectar→rain soften → killed: rains.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'tanutāpa' (slight anguish) is physical or mental is unresolved.", "Whether 'yadaiva' is temporal or conditional is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with adbhuta (wonder) / L2+L3 voice
